Use the app for real for two weeks, then decide whether Genbeya gets an official mobile client. See [[Roadmap#how-the-trial-is-judged]].

- [ ] Walk through every **Must** story in [[User stories]] on an Android phone and an iPhone, and the three moments of "A day with the app"
- [ ] Use it daily on genbeya/genbeya itself: its board, wiki and pull requests
- [ ] Watch the desktop for spurious diffs in files the app wrote
- [ ] Collect what was missed and what was never used
- [ ] Write the verdict and what an official client would need into [[Roadmap]]
- [ ] For genbeya/genbeya: move its tasks to the content branch, or use `mobile/<handle>` (D5)
- [ ] Note reviews that stopped at "approved, merge later" (D10) and reactions missed without notifications (D12)
